title: Independent verification: R480 packing optimum uniformly through a=1/2
body:
Ali Romman’s PR1129 already establishes the R480 packing optimum and an attaining T37 construction. This contribution adds an independent standard-library verifier bound to selected PR1094’s T16 inputs, checks PR1129’s fine root endpoints without importing its moment engines, and proves the same fractional optimum uniformly for every real **0 < a <= 1/2**. The related U8 supporting audit covers a <= 1/3; the new continuum argument uses exact square-root signs and concavity.

The package checks all **1,163** feasible bin patterns. Nine rational primal patterns match all capacity/helper inventories, and a symbolic dual attains their cost. A separate rational-squaring oracle confirms all endpoint inequalities. The verifier reconciles the primal exactly to PR1129’s T37 table scaled by 16/37 and the dual to its signed prices, independently recounts 69,120 selected owner rows, and confirms the existing root bracket `(0.001676905273619680861300, 0.001676905273619680861301)`.

**Scope:** fixed local paid profile, helper inventory, disjoint whole-helper reservations and child capacities. Pattern multiplicities, timing and family compatibility are relaxed. No new numerical optimum, kappa, physical owner construction, full cold replay or Lean theorem is claimed. The selected record and all frozen predecessors are unchanged.

Validation on CPython 3.12.13 / macOS arm64:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-t16-pattern-dual
python3.12 -I -O -B research/selected-t16-pattern-dual/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/selected-t16-pattern-dual/test_verify.py
git diff --cached --check
```

All pass: 11 semantic failure controls and nine test groups, including four predecessor-claim mutations and 64 exact integer-power comparisons. Discovery used SciPy; replay has no third-party dependency. Hosted CI is separate.

Started from current main `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`. Task `independent-moment`, nonce `14c8429d797658917dfffd38f0db810d`. [Coordination and final scope](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1885). Final full overlap snapshot covered 554 open PRs and 535 discussion records; limits and historical follow-up are recorded in TASK.json.

Credit Ali Romman (PR1129), Chafik Boukhalfa (PR795/1131 and signed prices), woklerx’s U8 uniform audit, Rohan Arun, Jeremy Kothe, Hao Yan and the retained supplier lineage. Nearby PR1783/1847 screens and PR1685 have explicit scope comparisons. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. No independent human review is claimed.
